metadata.coverage_preamble: Today holds the short loaf, the struck glass, and the three marks at St Helen's.

yesterday: The loaf was a penny and a finger and a half short. Four wands were ready. Gib stayed on the shut chronicle.
You struck the glass off the page. The king comes down off the wall.
The parish walked three marks in forty minutes. Alse showed them to Gillis. There was bread and ale after.
A precept against blue starch was spoken of, from Crosby Place.
Susanna is twelve tomorrow. The thimble went on the fifteenth.
